regions.label: raised rectangular paved street platform (pad) carrying the whole building cluster: pavement with crosswalks, lane markings and curb edge; surface largely washed out in the top view

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 铺装面大面积洗白（四角画布实测 RGB(255,254,254)、sat≤2），仅中部残留粉灰色调斑（u0.23-0.80/v0.31-0.65 密度最高）；杆列在 v≈0.002 与 v≈0.999 仍出现，证明底板南北贯穿并被画幅裁切。bounds=建筑/杆列范围外扩约 0.02 的近似矩形（画布网格线遮挡剖面无清晰边界，见 uncertainties）。ground-material-ne/nw/se/sw: 铺装面及白色斑马线、车道线、路口导流线在四斜视中清晰可见，底板为带厚度的升高板（边缘可见细沿口/阴影线），路面上并见蓝灰色斑块（另见 uncertainties）。

regions.label: continuous built-up band along the pad: two loose N-S building columns (west u≈0.04-0.55, east u≈0.55-0.96) in four rows, all with torn/uneven tops, scorch marks and rooftop debris

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 全部建筑类连通域（面积≥200px 共 30+ 个）落在该带内；东西两列由 u≈0.50-0.62 的中央南北街隔开，西列内部另有 u≈0.25-0.32 的街巷（灯杆列所在）；行间东西向街巷位于 v≈0.31-0.38/0.46/0.55/0.70/0.82-0.87/0.93+。ground-material-ne/nw/se/sw: 四斜视均为顶部残缺、立面燻黑、屋面堆散碎块的多层/高层楼群；bounds 取建筑连通域总外接框。

entities.label: white slab high-rise with dark scorch bands and a broken crown-like top, north-center; pink/red debris strip on its south roof edge; function unknown

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 白色板楼屋面（顶视连通域顶部 v0.059-0.177，其南缘接 2176px 粉红瓦砾条带 (388,320)-(492,348) RGB(172,147,140)，一并计入 bounds）。ground-material-ne: 该塔居画面右中、顶部呈冠状残缺并立细尖柱群；ground-material-se: 同塔居画面上中（全场景最高）。用途不作判定。

entities.label: large beige ruined mega-structure at northwest-center: dark gray west rim, smooth white dome-like collapsed debris masses on the east roof, yellow-green patch and pinkish debris bits; function unknown

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 主连通域 89132px（182,318-492,818）RGB(217,212,202)，西缘暗灰带、东半屋面多个光滑白色穹顶状隆起；黄绿色斑 (280,610)-(306,662)；粉调碎块 (354,354)-(372,438)、(382,432)-(446,486)、(354,720)-(380,742)。ground-material-ne: 右中巨型米色残楼（白色熔状穹顶清晰）；ground-material-se: 上中同一综合体；ground-material-nw/sw: 左侧/左中大体积米色残楼同见。用途不作判定。

entities.label: ruined building cluster north-center-east: white slab towers with scorch, a pink-debris roof block and a blue-parapet block with dark broken roof; internal composition partly unresolved; function unknown

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 簇级连通域 61836px（500,108-718,550）RGB(229,228,231)；内部蓝框屋面块（蓝类连通域 (584,388)-(640,416)、(584,460)-(640,524)、(588,420)-(636,446)、(562,366)-(656,374)）与粉调屋顶斑块共存，单个建筑界线部分不可分（见 uncertainties）。ground-material-ne: 中部白板楼群带燻黑与红砖面色块；ground-material-nw: 中左同类楼群；ground-material-se: 中部白楼群。用途不作判定。

entities.label: mid-rise block at center-east with gray roof carrying machinery-like rooftop units; function unknown

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 连通域 16432px（556,688-728,798）RGB(227,225,217)，屋面上可见数个方形突出物（机房状）。ground-material-ne/sw: 中右灰顶多层楼同见；ground-material-se: 中部灰顶楼。用途不作判定。

entities.label: white multi-story block at the west edge with a small attached annex; function unknown

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 连通域 15048px（36,852-190,966）RGB(230,229,222)，为西列中段独立白楼，东侧带小附属体（(100,890)-(122,936) 等）。ground-material-nw: 左端白板楼近观（立面竖条纹）；ground-material-ne: 远右白块群对应。用途不作判定。

entities.label: small dark low block at center (darkest rooftop in the scene); function unknown

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 连通域 2824px（562,870-624,936）RGB(116,114,108)，为全区最暗的整块屋面。ground-material-ne: 中部深色矮块；ground-material-sw: 中部深灰平顶小块同见。用途不作判定。

entities.label: blue-framed building at the east edge: blue parapet/roof frame with dark blue broken interior sections; function unknown

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 蓝类连通域 (692,868)-(770,922) 与 (768,868)-(828,924)（RGB(120,140,160)/(95,108,124)）构成屋面两段深蓝破碎区，外框蓝灰色；bounds 取整楼外接框（总域 17092px）。ground-material-nw: 右端蓝灰楼近观；ground-material-ne: 中右蓝灰楼；ground-material-sw: 中右蓝灰楼同见。用途不作判定。

entities.label: very pale flat-roof block at center-west (near the washout threshold); function unknown

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 浅白平顶连通域 7232px（302,864-430,940）RGB(245,245,245)，仅比画布（254）暗约 9 灰度级，界线可辨但接近洗白阈值（另见 uncertainties）。ground-material-nw: 左中白色矮块群对应；ground-material-sw: 中左白色平顶块。

entities.label: ruined white building cluster southwest: several white flat roofs, a tilted brown-roof piece and dark debris; internal boundaries partly unresolved; function unknown

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 簇级连通域 98876px 的北半部（66,990-476,1400 内 v0.55-0.70 段），含多个白色平顶、棕褐色倾斜屋面块（(394,1178)-(454,1228) RGB(165,151,121) 小棕块等）与深色碎块；内部界线经阴影/淡斑粘连不可全分（见 uncertainties）。ground-material-nw: 左中白色楼群及一块明显倾斜的白色板体；ground-material-se: 左中白楼群+倾斜件同见。用途不作判定。

entities.label: blue building at southwest with a large light-blue tilted slab (collapsed/leaning panel) beside it; function unknown

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 深蓝屋面块 (150,1334)-(206,1442) RGB(96,110,127) + 其南浅蓝段 (150,1444)-(206,1472) + 北缘蓝条 (134,1310)-(218,1330)；其西南侧浅蓝倾斜板（v0.78-0.92 段，蓝类 1124px）呈斜置平行四边形，是全区唯一明显非水平大构件。ground-material-nw: 左侧白色板体明显向街面倾斜近观；ground-material-se: 左下角白/灰斜板搭在路面上；ground-material-sw: 左缘蓝楼+斜板同见。倾斜板与主楼的连接关系未定（见 uncertainties）。用途不作判定。

entities.label: low block at center-south with a dark brown debris-covered roof and yellow-green strips on its north edge; function unknown

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 连通域 16928px（338,1284-474,1462）RGB(208,198,182)，屋面大部分为深褐碎块状纹理，北缘两条黄绿条带（(358,1270)-(442,1278)、(356,1284)-(408,1300)）与东侧绿条 (488,1324)-(492,1380)。ground-material-sw: 中部褐顶残块近观；ground-material-se: 中下褐顶块同见。用途不作判定。

entities.label: pair of very pale white flat-roof blocks at south (near washout threshold); function unknown

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 浅白平顶连通域 4436px（332,1562-460,1638）RGB(246,246,246) 及其西段 (332,1590)-(348,1638)，接近画布灰度（另见 uncertainties）。ground-material-sw: 中下白色平顶矮块对应；ground-material-se: 远处白平顶。

entities.label: ruined pair at center-east: a brown/tan heavily damaged block with pink debris and a white slab neighbor; function unknown

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 北块 9060px（568,1000-696,1128）RGB(199,189,168) 褐色破损屋面带粉调碎块 (608,1020)-(630,1046) 与绿点 (676,1024)-(684,1058)；南块 6548px（562,1114-730,1246）RGB(232,231,224) 白色板顶；bounds 取两块并集。ground-material-sw: 中部褐残楼+白楼紧贴近观；ground-material-ne/se: 中部同类楼群。用途不作判定。

entities.label: large beige ruined mega-structure at southeast (twin of the northwest one): dark rim, white dome-like debris masses on the south roof, yellow-green patch, pink debris bits and a white tower piece at its west edge; function unknown

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 主连通域 81304px（556,1284-860,1672）RGB(215,210,202)，形态与西北综合体成对：暗缘、白色穹顶状隆起群（南半）、黄绿斑 (708,1368)-(740,1386)、粉调碎块 (560,1308)-(592,1348)/(674,1568)-(710,1670)/(570,1562)-(602,1584)/(642,1540)-(670,1550)/(598,1538)-(636,1550)，西缘白塔件 (560,1416)-(574,1496)。ground-material-se: 中下巨型米色残楼近观（穹顶清晰）；ground-material-ne: 左端同楼；ground-material-nw: 右侧大块米色残楼；ground-material-sw: 右中大体积米色残楼。用途不作判定。

entities.label: rows of thin pole-like structures (presumed street lighting, unconfirmed) flanking the west internal N-S street: two columns at u≈0.25/0.31 plus isolated poles, spacing ≈4 m
small yellow-green patches on four rooftops (moss/lichen-like tone; origin unresolved: vegetation vs paint vs debris)
